purpose: Replace the PHP54 Cartesian-resolution wall with an exact polynomial matching/cardinality quotient when the CNF is exactly recognized as an injective-assignment instance.

scientific_boundary.claim: This closes the known PHP-family representation barrier only; it is not a P=NP proof.

requirements: Variables bijectively encode allowed left-right edges x[p,h].
For every left vertex p there is exactly one positive clause OR_h x[p,h] over its allowed neighbors.
For every right vertex h, pairwise negative clauses forbid two distinct left vertices from simultaneously using h.
No extra clauses are admitted by this lane.
Recognition is syntactic/structural and polynomial; ambiguity returns OPEN.

graph_semantics.edge_meaning: (p,h) in E iff variable x[p,h] is allowed
graph_semantics.sat_criterion: The CNF is satisfiable iff G has a matching covering every p in P.
graph_semantics.unsat_certificate: A Hall-deficient set S subseteq P with |N(S)| < |S|, or an independently replayable maximum-matching certificate from which such deficiency is derived.

hall_tension.definition: tau_H(G)=|P|-nu(G), where nu(G) is the cardinality of a maximum matching

meaning.0: A matching covering all left vertices exists.
meaning.>0: At least tau_H left vertices cannot be injectively assigned.

hall_tension.authority: Exact diagnostic/certificate quantity, not a confidence score.

php_family_theorem.statement: For full PHP_{m,n}, G=K_{m,n}, nu(G)=min(m,n). Therefore if m>n then tau_H=m-n>0 and the CNF is UNSAT.

cardinality_quotient.after_eliminating_k_left_vertices: The exact residual condition contributed by the eliminated prefix is: at least k distinct holes are free of all remaining left vertices.
proof_sketch: If an extension for k eliminated left vertices exists, choose one occupied hole per eliminated vertex; hole exclusivity makes these k holes distinct and unused by remaining vertices.

Conversely, if k holes are free of all remaining vertices, assign the k eliminated vertices injectively to those free holes; all original positive-demand and right-capacity clauses for the eliminated vertices are satisfied.
cardinality_quotient.terminal_contradiction: If k>|H|, AtLeast_k over |H| holes is false.

algorithmic_repair.old_route: PHP -> generic resolution/FRP -> 121 raw pivot pairs -> 105 non-tautological resolvents -> cap failure
algorithmic_repair.new_route: EXACT_RECOGNIZE_INJECTIVE_ASSIGNMENT -> BUILD_BIPARTITE_GRAPH -> MAXIMUM_MATCHING/HALL_CERTIFICATE -> SAT_WITNESS or UNSAT_CERTIFICATE
algorithmic_repair.complexity: Polynomial in the graph/CNF encoding size using a standard exact bipartite maximum-matching algorithm.

m2r_backward_interpretation.future_contract: All left demands must be satisfiable under unit capacity of right resources.
m2r_backward_interpretation.backward_return: Pull back the terminal feasibility requirement to the present Hall-capacity condition.
m2r_backward_interpretation.dirac_reset: The predictive/research trace may be discarded after producing the independently replayable matching/Hall receipt; source CNF remains unchanged.

consequence_for_stage4.PHP54_new_interpretation: The 105-resolvent wall is evidence that generic explicit resolution missed a tractable matching/cardinality quotient; it is not evidence of intrinsic hardness of the PHP family.

next_open_target.requirement: Choose a connected arbitrary-CNF family that is not already discharged by exact Schaefer/algebraic/component/matching-cardinality lanes, then test nested factor-interface closure under a frozen schedule.
next_open_target.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat failure of one representation on a tractable family as evidence for general SAT hardness.
